nonconformities.detail: The implementation compared raw normalized coefficient vectors even though the frozen result reports a 173-dimensional value-nuisance nullspace. Coefficient projection is therefore not invariant under feature representations of the same observable function.

The locked specification required tests against angular momentum squared, exact Reynolds identities, constants on the fixed-energy surface, and any reconstructed exact formula. The implementation tested only Euclidean coefficient projection against one angular-momentum-squared representative.

The carried family-fold diagnostic also projected coefficient representatives rather than observable response subspaces, so its failure cannot distinguish a new direction from a nullspace-shifted known direction.

nonqualifying_trigger_observation.purpose: Motivate a corrected predeclared protocol; these values are not themselves qualification evidence.

required_remediation: Resolve the candidate in observable function space with a training-only fitted scale, held-out response checks, source-disjoint high-precision physical angular momentum, and backend comparisons modulo the full value-nuisance representation kernel.
